load_config_from_file: load a config from a python json or yaml file using Config.fromfile
merge_config_options: merge a dictionary of options into an existing Config object using merge_from_dict
dump_config_to_file: dump a Config object to a python json or yaml file using the dump method
parse_cli_args_to_dict: parse command line arguments into a dictionary using DictAction with argparse
auto_generate_argparser: auto generate an argparse ArgumentParser from a config file using Config.auto_argparser
